card.title: Anything but That Question
card.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?
